basic_profile.bio: A 24-year-old graduate student currently residing in Portland, Oregon. I have a keen interest in international development and sustainable investing, which aligns with my studies in environmental economics. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new hobbies like learning about Magic: The Gathering and indulging in BL series. I'm fairly new to Reddit and am still learning the ropes of its community nuances. I typically log in during evenings and late nights. Currently single and focusing on my studies and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My academic background is rooted in environmental economics, which I study at a local university. My interest in BL novels stems from online communities and fan forums, where I've picked up a lot about the genre's popular titles and authors. I am also self-taught in Magic: The Gathering through online guides and tutorials.
